part.text: 参考画像を拝見しました。レーシングカートをFreeCADでモデリングし、FCStd/STEPで保存します。まず全体の構成をTODOとして整理します。
まずフレーム(青パイプ)を構築するスクリプトを一括実行します。必要なパーツを一度に作る方が一貫性があるため、セクションごとに続きのスクリプトを組んでいきます。

import FreeCAD as App, Part, math

doc = App.newDocument("racing-kart")

BLUE=(0.11,0.31,0.86); DARK=(0.13,0.13,0.15); GRAY=(0.72,0.74,0.78)
SLV=(0.82,0.82,0.85); ENG=(0.50,0.52,0.56); TIRE=(0.08,0.08,0.10)
BODY=(0.80,0.82,0.86); SEAT=(0.22,0.24,0.28)

groups={}; made=[]
def grp(nm):
    if nm not in groups:
        groups[nm]=doc.addObject("App::DocumentObjectGroup",nm)
    return groups[nm]

def add(shape,nm,color,g):
    o=doc.addObject("Part::Feature",nm); o.Label=nm
    o.Shape=shape; o.ViewObject.ShapeColor=color
    grp(g).addObject(o); made.append(o)
    return o

def V(x,y,z): return App.Vector(x,y,z)

def tube(p1p,p2p,r,nm,color=BLUE,g="Frame"):
    p1=V(*p1p); p2=V(*p2p); v=p2-p1
    s=Part.makeCylinder(r,v.Length)
    ax=V(0,0,1).cross(v)
    ax = ax.normalize() if ax.Length>1e-9 else V(1,0,0)
    s.Placement=App.Placement(p1, App.Rotation(ax, math.degrees(V(0,0,1).getAngle(v))))
    add(s,nm,color,g)

def boxc(c,lwh,nm,color,g,rot=None,fr=None):
    l,w,h=lwh
    b=Part.makeBox(l,w,h,V(-l/2,-w/2,-h/2))
    if fr:
        vs=[e for e in b.Edges if abs(e.Curve.Direction.z)>0.99]
        b=b.makeFillet(fr,vs)
    b.Placement=App.Placement(V(*c), App.Rotation(V(*rot[0]),rot[1]) if rot else App.Rotation())
    add(b,nm,color,g)

def cylx(c,r,w,nm,color,g):
    s=Part.makeCylinder(r,w)
    s.Placement=App.Placement(V(c[0]-w/2.0,c[1],c[2]), App.Rotation(V(0,1,0),90))
    add(s,nm,color,g)

# ---------------- FRAME (blue tubes) ----------------
# side rails
for sgn,tag in [(1,"R"),(-1,"L")]:
    x=245*sgn
    tube((x,430,95),(x,300,100),"Rail%s_1"%tag)
    tube((x,300,100),(x,60,105),"Rail%s_2"%tag)
    tube((x,60,105),(x,-180,105),"Rail%s_3"%tag)
    tube((x,-180,105),(x,-350,105),"Rail%s_4"%tag)
    tube((x,-350,105),(x,-520,100),"Rail%s_5"%tag)
# cross members
tube((-245,430,95),(245,430,95),16,"CrossFR")
tube((-245,300,100),(245,300,100),16,"Cross300")
tube((-245,60,105),(245,60,105),16,"Cross60")
tube((-245,-180,105),(245,-180,105),16,"Cross_180")
tube((-245,-350,105),(245,-350,105),16,"Cross_350")
tube((-245,-520,100),(245,-520,100),16,"CrossRear")
# front axle members
tube((-420,430,130),(-245,430,130),14,"AxleFL")
tube((245,430,130),(420,430,130),14,"AxleFR")
# rear rail bends out to bearings
tube((-245,-520,100),(-245,-560,140),14,"RailBLend_L")
tube((245,-520,100),(245,-560,140),14,"RailBLend_R")
# seat supports
tube((-245,-180,105),(-140,-160,85),12,"SeatSupL")
tube((245,-180,105),(140,-160,85),12,"SeatSupR")
# steering supports
tube((-200,330,100),(0,395,130),12,"SteerSupL")
tube((200,330,100),(0,395,130),12,"SteerSupR")

# floor pan
boxc((0,40,55),(520,780,10),"FloorPan",GRAY,"Frame")

doc.recompute()
print("frame done, objects:", len(made))

import FreeCAD as App, Part, math
doc = App.getDocument("racing-kart")

BLUE=(0.11,0.31,0.86); DARK=(0.13,0.13,0.15); GRAY=(0.72,0.74,0.78)
SLV=(0.82,0.82,0.85); TIRE=(0.08,0.08,0.10)
BODY=(0.80,0.82,0.86); SEAT=(0.22,0.24,0.28)

def V(x,y,z): return App.Vector(x,y,z)
made=[]
def grp(nm):
    if nm not in [g.Name for g in doc.Objects if hasattr(g,'TypeId') and 'DocumentObjectGroup' in g.TypeId]:
        groupsnm=doc.getObjectsByLabel(nm)
        if groupsnm: return groupsnm[0]
        return doc.addObject("App::DocumentObjectGroup",nm)
    return [o for o in doc.Objects if o.Name==nm or o.Label==nm][0]

def add(shape,nm,color,g):
    o=doc.addObject("Part::Feature",nm); o.Label=nm
    o.Shape=shape; o.ViewObject.ShapeColor=color
    grp(g).addObject(o); made.append(o)
    return o

def tube(p1p,p2p,r,nm,color=BLUE,g="Frame"):
    p1=V(*p1p); p2=V(*p2p); v=p2-p1
    s=Part.makeCylinder(r,v.Length)
    ax=V(0,0,1).cross(v)
    ax = ax.normalize() if ax.Length>1e-9 else V(1,0,0)
    s.Placement=App.Placement(p1, App.Rotation(ax, math.degrees(V(0,0,1).getAngle(v))))
    add(s,nm,color,g)

def boxc(c,lwh,nm,color,g,rot=None,fr=None):
    l,w,h=lwh
    b=Part.makeBox(l,w,h,V(-l/2,-w/2,-h/2))
    if fr:
        vs=[e for e in b.Edges if abs(e.Curve.Direction.z)>0.99]
        b=b.makeFillet(fr,vs)
    b.Placement=App.Placement(V(*c), App.Rotation(V(*rot[0]),rot[1]) if rot else App.Rotation())
    add(b,nm,color,g)

# ---------------- SEAT ----------------
boxc((0,-60,85),(380,250,28),"SeatPan",SEAT,"Seat",fr=14)
boxc((0,-250,330),(370,35,470),"SeatBack",SEAT,"Seat",rot=((1,0,0),12))
boxc((165,-245,330),(35,70,450),"SeatBolsterR",SEAT,"Seat",rot=((1,0,0),12))
boxc((-165,-245,330),(35,70,450),"SeatBolsterL",SEAT,"Seat",rot=((1,0,0),12))

# ---------------- STEERING ----------------
tube((0,385,130),(0,455,430),11,"SteerColumn",SLV,"Steering")
d=V(0,70,300).normalize()
ax=V(0,0,1).cross(d); ax=ax.normalize()
rc=App.Rotation(ax, math.degrees(V(0,0,1).getAngle(d)))
center=V(0,455,430)
tor=Part.makeTorus(145,17)
tor.Placement=App.Placement(center,rc)
add(tor,"SteerWheel",DARK,"Steering")
for i,a in enumerate((90,210,330)):
    s=Part.makeCylinder(9,143)
    s.rotate(V(0,0,0),V(0,1,0),90)
    s.rotate(V(0,0,0),V(0,0,1),a)
    s.Placement=App.Placement(center,rc)
    add(s,"SteerSpoke%d"%i,SLV,"Steering")
hub=Part.makeCylinder(22,46)
hub.rotate(V(0,0,0),V(0,1,0),90)
hub.Placement=App.Placement(center,rc)
add(hub,"SteerHub",DARK,"Steering")

# ---------------- REAR BUMPER (black) ----------------
tube((-280,-700,130),(280,-700,130),20,"BumpBar",DARK,"Bumper")
tube((-280,-700,130),(-280,-560,145),16,"BumpPostL",DARK,"Bumper")
tube((280,-700,130),(280,-560,145),16,"BumpPostR",DARK,"Bumper")
tube((-245,-520,100),(-280,-700,130),16,"BumpLinkL",DARK,"Bumper")
tube((245,-520,100),(280,-700,130),16,"BumpLinkR",DARK,"Bumper")
# arch behind seat
tube((-245,-350,105),(-225,-335,300),16,"ArchV_L",DARK,"Bumper")
tube((-225,-335,300),(-225,-335,560),16,"ArchT_L",DARK,"Bumper")
tube((245,-350,105),(225,-335,300),16,"ArchV_R",DARK,"Bumper")
tube((225,-335,300),(225,-335,560),16,"ArchT_R",DARK,"Bumper")
tube((-225,-335,560),(225,-335,560),20,"ArchTop",DARK,"Bumper")

doc.recompute()
print("seat/steer/bumper done, new objects:", len(made))

import FreeCAD as App, Part, math
doc = App.getDocument("racing_kart1")

BODY=(0.80,0.82,0.86)
made=[]

def grp(nm):
    for g in doc.Objects:
        if g.Name==nm: return g
    return doc.addObject("App::DocumentObjectGroup",nm)

def add(shape,nm,color,g):
    o=doc.addObject("Part::Feature",nm); o.Label=nm
    o.Shape=shape; o.ViewObject.ShapeColor=color
    grp(g).addObject(o); made.append(o)
    return o

def V(x,y,z): return App.Vector(x,y,z)

# ---------------- NOSE CONE (loft of ellipses) ----------------
frames=[]
for (y,rx,rz,zc) in [(692,168,105,150),(560,205,118,145),(420,248,132,138)]:
    e=Part.Ellipse(V(0,0,0),rx,rz)
    w=Part.Wire([e.toShape()])
    w.Placement=App.Placement(V(0,y,zc), App.Rotation(V(1,0,0),90))
    frames.append(w)
nose=Part.makeLoft(frames,True)
add(nose,"NoseCone",BODY,"Bodywork")

# front splitter plate
l,w,h=290,150,22
b=Part.makeBox(l,w,h,V(-l/2,-w/2,-h/2))
b.Placement=App.Placement(V(0,650,42),App.Rotation())
add(b,"Splitter",BODY,"Bodywork")

# side pods (rounded boxes) left & right
for sgn,tag in [(1,"R"),(-1,"L")]:
    l,w,h=160,430,135
    b=Part.makeBox(l,w,h,V(-l/2,-w/2,-h/2))
    vs=[e2 for e2 in b.Edges if abs(e2.Curve.Direction.z)>0.99]
    b=b.makeFillet(55,vs)
    b.Placement=App.Placement(V(348*sgn,100,125),App.Rotation())
    add(b,"SidePod_%s"%tag,BODY,"Bodywork")

doc.recompute()
print("bodywork done, new objects:", len(made))

def tube(p1p,p2p,r,nm,color,g="Engine"):

    add(s,nm,color,g)

レーシングカートの作成・保存が完了しました。

**成果物**
- `racing-kart.FCStd` (115 KB) — FreeCADドキュメント。ツリーは Frame / Seat / Steering / Bodywork / Bumper / Wheels / Drivetrain / Engine のグループで整理
- `racing-kart.step` (381 KB) — STEP形式、77形状エクスポート済み

**モデル構成(77ソリッド)**
- **フレーム**: 青の鋼管パイプ構造(サイドレール、クロスメンバー、フロント/リアアクスル受け、シート支持材)+ フロアパン
- **ボディ**: ノーズコーン(楕円断面のロフト生成)、フロントスプリッター、左右サイドポッド(角R付き)
- **黒パーツ**: リアバンパー一式(メインバー、支持材、シート背後のアーチ)、シート(パン・背もたれ・サイドボルスター)
- **操行系**: ハンドル(リング+3本スポーク)、 tilted ステアリングコラム
- **駆動系**: リアアクスル、ベアリングボックス、スプロケット、ブレーキディスク、エンジン(クランクケース/ブロック/シリンダヘッド+フィン/キャブレタ)、マフラー(テールパイプ付き)
- **ホイール**: 前105幅/After175幅のリアタイヤ(2XLサイズ差を表現)+ アルミリム + ハブ

**寸法検証**： 全体 1075 × 1445 × 580 mm ≈ 参照図面の 1040 × 1400 mm とほぼ一致
